definition: A rule or choice the sources do not settle in figures, so the corpus hands it to you instead of inventing a threshold. It is listed for you to review by eye and is never counted as passed or failed.
basis: schema/constraint.schema.json, the scope field: judgment "means the sources do not determine this numerically", and such a constraint "is listed for hand review, never silently passed or invented a threshold for". schema/kit.schema.json says the same of a slot marked judgment: "The sources do not determine this and a designer must decide." VISION.md states the commitment: "A rule the sources do not determine is deferred to the human, never invented."
more: Not the same as unjudged. An unjudged check is one the machine would run and could not, for want of a figure; a rule yours to judge has no machine test at all, by design, because the sources give it none.
